q: How do I calculate a solar cell plant's carbon footprint per watt?
title: Solar cell plant carbon per watt
short: Divide the plant's electricity and fuel emissions by the watts of cells produced, rated at standard test conditions. Electricity for furnaces, cleanrooms and chillers dominates. Purchased wafers carry most of a cell's embodied carbon, so report them separately in Scope 3.

ul: Monthly electricity bills, including open access or rooftop solar.
Watts of cells produced, from production records.
Wafers bought, with supplier figures if available.

p: Some cell lines use fluorinated gases for cleaning or etching. Losses of gases covered by the GHG Protocol count in Scope 1.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
